profile.name: Anas Zuhairi bin Zullkeffle
profile.headline: Robotics & Automation Engineering Technology Student
profile.tagline: I build machines that sense, sort and decide — from PLC-driven conveyor systems to AI vision and immersive WebXR heritage galleries.
summary: Results-oriented Electrical & Mechatronics Engineering Technology student specialising in Robotics and Automation at Universiti Malaysia Perlis (UniMAP).
Hands-on industrial experience in precision machine assembly, component measurement, preventive maintenance and process optimisation at leading technology manufacturers — Micron Memory and ViTrox.
I enjoy turning messy real-world problems into reliable automated systems: Omron PLC logic, pneumatics and actuators, camera-based vision inspection and data-driven troubleshooting.

bullets: Executed preventive and corrective maintenance on 21 high-precision semiconductor production machines, mitigating defect root causes and measurably reducing rejected product.
Analysed production and process data during high-volume peak seasons to find bottlenecks and optimise machine parameters.
Implemented machine conversion and set-up protocols to adapt equipment quickly to strict customer specification changes.
Directed 30 line operators and supported 10 shift technicians to keep machinery at peak precision and throughput.
Performed precision mechanical assembly, dimensional measurement and calibration of automated vision-inspection system components using specialised metrology equipment.
Verified mechanical tolerances and surface compliance against engineering specifications before customer shipment.
Mentored incoming interns on standardised precision assembly and quality-assurance procedures.
Independent route planning and time allocation in a high-volume, self-regulated environment while maintaining consistent performance standards.

projects.title: AUREWAS
projects.subtitle: PLC-Based Automatic Conveyor Sorting System for Recyclable Waste
projects.context: Final Year Project 1 · UniMAP · Festival Idea Putrajaya 2026 — Innovation Challenge
projects.summary: Mixed recyclables are still sorted by hand at recycling centres, schools and community collection points — slow, inconsistent and unsafe. AUREWAS is an affordable automatic conveyor that separates waste by material, built for small centres that can't afford industrial sorting lines.
highlights: Omron CP2E-N PLC reads three sensors: inductive (metal), capacitive (plastic) and photoelectric (presence). Present-but-neither is classified as paper.
24 V push-pull solenoids eject each item into its own bin at the right moment.
Built from affordable industrial components and a 3D-printed frame.
Proposed to SWCorp Perlis as a real-world case study · supports SDG 11 & 12.
projects.team: With Muhammad Alynajmi bin Mohd Khairruddin · Supervisor: Dr. Syatirah binti Mohd Noor

projects.title: Galeri Warisan Maya
projects.subtitle: The Living Heritage Gallery — a WebXR virtual-reality museum
projects.context: DICE 4.0 (KPT & UniSZA) · Category 3: Interactive Media (AR/VR) · Theme: Warisan
projects.summary: A browser-based VR gallery where visitors physically walk through a Malay heritage environment. Interactive exhibits of traditional dance, singing and silat come alive through proximity triggers and spatial audio — no app install, it runs straight from the browser and on Meta Quest 2.
highlights: Team Leader & WebXR developer for Pasukan DICE 4.0 UniMAP.
Six heritage branches: Performing Arts, Clothing & Textiles, Crafts & Weaponry, Heritage Food, Customs & Literature, and Architecture.
Room-scale locomotion, proximity-triggered exhibits and spatial-audio falloff.
Built with Three.js and the WebXR Device API, hosted on GitHub Pages.
projects.team: With Muhammad Afifi bin Muhd Shukri, Baraah Ali Omar Balagem & Ahmad Haziq bin Ariff · Mentor: Dr. Mohd Hafiz Ismail

projects.title: AI-REWAS
projects.subtitle: AI-Powered Vision & Automated Segregation System
projects.summary: The next generation of AUREWAS: replacing proximity sensing with camera-based AI vision for material identification and surface-geometry classification.
highlights: Experimental trials to evaluate optical identification accuracy.
Real-time vision output integrated with Omron PLC control for fast, precise actuation.
Iterative parameter tuning to raise throughput and operational safety.

projects.title: Stock Take Monitoring & FIFO Inventory
projects.subtitle: Database monitoring system for raw-material inventory
projects.summary: A database-driven stock monitoring system that controls raw-material inventory using FIFO logic for the Kimie Z Ayam Goreng warehouse.
highlights: Designed and deployed with pgAdmin and XAMPP.
Presented to industry representatives at the Electrical Mechatronic Design Innovation Expo (EMDIEX 2026).
